name: Superhero
tagline: Your own original hero, cinematic and emblem-free.
description: Become an original superhero, not anyone else's: custom suits with no emblems or trademarked looks, rooftop vigils, hero landings, flight above the clouds, energy and ice powers, a high-tech headquarters and a 60s retro hero. Face always visible, no masks and no weapons.
